title: Malicious code in brambletask (PyPI)
description: The brambletask package on PyPI version 0.1.0 is part of a coordinated malicious campaign involving loader packages that execute code from remote URLs. Although the packages themselves do not contain the payload, they facilitate downloading and executing remote malicious scripts. This campaign is identified as having clear malicious intent, such as infostealing.
aiSummary: The brambletask package version 0.1.0 is involved in a campaign distributing loader packages designed to execute code fetched from remote URLs. These packages do not embed the malicious payload directly but serve as a mechanism to load and run malicious scripts remotely. The campaign is coordinated and aims to provide multiple deceptive methods for loading malicious code, with intent linked to infostealing activities.
aiImpact: Users installing or using brambletask version 0.1.0 risk executing remote malicious scripts, potentially leading to information theft or other malicious outcomes. The package acts as a loader, enabling attackers to run arbitrary code on affected systems.
